top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs two designed molecular principles that changed what researchers and clinicians can do: base editing (evolved deaminases giving single-base chemical conversion without a double-strand break) and PROTAC induced-proximity degradation (Crews and Deshaies, 2001 concept, quantifiable ternary-complex mechanism). Crediting Liu alone for base editing is the weakest point, so I rank the Liu/Komor/Gaudelli single-part prize (P002) next. The Liu part is shared by P003 and P004, but their second parts (C-N coupling after the 2010 cross-coupling prize; dye-sensitized cells) are less generative for my test than degradation, and any award is preferred to none.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no tie to any credited name, only overlapping self-assembly and peptide interests with Emma Sparr, whose lipid-nanoparticle topic is not on the slate
